package br.exemplo.cobranca;

import jakarta.persistence.*;

/** Fatura mensal da conta. */
@Entity
@EntityListeners(AuditingEntityListener.class)
@NoArgsConstructor(access = AccessLevel.PROTECTED)
@Table(name = "faturas", indexes = { @Index(name = "ix_fatura_conta", columnList = "conta_id") })
public class Fatura {
    @Column(name = Colunas.VALOR)
    private BigDecimal valor;
}
